tasks.short: Monitor pumping equipment and report abnormalities

steps.what: Verify the actual equipment identities, required tank levels, temperatures, chemical amounts and pressure limits for this operation
inputs: Actual current operating instruction and equipment
Existing pump control and operating log system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual verified tag identities and explicit current limits with units

steps.what: Monitor actual gauges and flowmeters and inspect equipment, capturing the actual readings and abnormal observations under the existing round
inputs: Actual equipment and instruments
Verified identities and limits from s1
outputs: Actual captured readings with times and units and operator observations

steps.what: Compare exact captured readings with the verified explicit limits in the native round view
inputs: Actual readings captured in s2
Explicit verified tag, unit and limit mapping from s1
outputs: Draft exact in-range and out-of-range comparisons with stale or missing values exposed

steps.what: Assess actual abnormalities, write the actual problem report and check its entire final meaning, urgency, equipment and internal recipient
inputs: Actual observations from s2 and comparisons from s3
Current operating and reporting instruction
outputs: Exact complete checked abnormality record and report with human-selected urgency and recipient

steps.what: Save the exact checked abnormality record in the existing log
inputs: Exact final record checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual abnormality record

steps.what: Send the exact checked abnormality report to the selected internal operating or maintenance colleague
inputs: Exact final report, urgency and recipient checked in s4
outputs: Actual internal abnormality report sent with delivery result

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} comparisons of actual captured round readings against verified current limits. Retain live monitoring, inspection, abnormality judgement and the actual report, with separate checked save and internal report send.
tasks.previous_blocker: A round can include repeated manual comparison of recorded values against explicit operating limits.
tasks.enabler_now: Native limit views can compare exact readings and expose missing or stale values without interpreting equipment condition.
tasks.still_hard: Abnormal equipment behaviour can matter even when a displayed value is inside a numerical limit.
tasks.human_edge: Combine direct inspection and current process knowledge when judging an abnormality.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configured operating views can compare exact values with explicit limits but do not replace direct equipment inspection or operational abnormality judgement.

assumptions: This conditional non-emergency round includes actual manual recorded-value comparison and an actual abnormality report. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the prompt prior.
The operator verifies all applicable limits and tag identities in s1 and captures actual readings and observations in s2. No free telemetry, new sensor or automatically chosen safe limit is assumed.
Try native views first. Already active alarms, comparisons, interlocks and their runtime are baseline and earn no new gain. Physical monitoring and response effort are not removed.

Missing or stale values remain exposed and require retained manual resolution. No automatic alert, control write, trip or shutdown is added. Existing urgent action and reporting retain priority and effort.
The complete final report exists before s4 checking; changed observations or recipients invalidate the gates. Save is negligible and neither save nor report send earns saving.
unknowns: Actual manual comparison work beyond existing alarms and actual reporting channel
research_questions: Which recorded comparisons remain manual during an observed pump round?

already_counted.description: Actual limit verification, direct monitoring and full abnormality report writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain verified limit mappings and test unit and missing-value exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete actual abnormality record checked in s4; changed observations invalidate it.
Exact complete report, urgency and internal recipient checked in s4; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85; gross saving=15 from actual manual comparisons. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 12. Existing alarms, physical inspection, save and send earn no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record actual products, pumping quantities, stocks, gauging and operating times

steps.what: Identify the actual pumping operation and verify and capture its product, stock sources, equipment tags, time window and quantity rules
inputs: Actual pumping instruction and existing transfer records
Existing transfer historian and operating log system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual verified operation identifiers, source selections and explicit recording and quantity rules

steps.what: Read and capture actual field gauging and stock observations and verify the relevant existing meter and operating-time evidence
inputs: Actual gauges, field observations and existing historian events
Verified operation from s1
outputs: Actual captured readings, stock observations, start and stop evidence with units and source associations

steps.what: Import exact selected transfer identifiers, gauge values, stock readings and operating events into the native operating record draft
inputs: Actual captured and verified sources from s1-s2
outputs: Draft source-linked operating record with missing and unmatched entries exposed

steps.what: Calculate the explicit selected pumped quantities, stock changes and elapsed operating times from actual source values
inputs: Actual imported values from s3
Explicit quantity and time rules captured in s1
outputs: Draft reproducible recorded quantities and operating-time calculations

steps.what: Complete the actual operating entry and check the entire final record against products, sources, units, gauging, quantity reconciliation and times
inputs: Complete draft record and calculations from s3-s4
Actual original evidence from s1-s2
outputs: Exact complete checked actual operating record with unresolved discrepancies identified

steps.what: Commit the exact checked actual operating data record
inputs: Exact complete record checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual operating data record

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} imports of actual transfer evidence and explicit quantity and elapsed-time calculations. Keep actual field reading, operation identification, discrepancy resolution and the complete final record check human before committing.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual manually compiled pumping log repeats source values and fixed arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native operating records can reuse exact selected values and calculate explicit stock, quantity and time formulas.
tasks.still_hard: Meter resets, mismatched stocks or incomplete event times can make an arithmetic total misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Reconcile the record with what was actually pumped and observed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact transfer readings and operating events can be imported into records and used in explicit quantity and elapsed-time calculations.

assumptions: This conditional episode contains actual manual transfer and arithmetic in an operating log. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the supplied prior.

Existing instruments produce historian events as baseline operations; their capture is not free new work. The operator still selects and verifies actual sources in s1 and obtains field-only readings and checks evidence in s2.
No free product mapping, corrected gauge quantity or missing event is assumed. Units, formulas and associations are explicitly selected and captured; unresolved gaps return to retained manual work.
Try native historian and log configuration first. Already automatic log values, quantity formulas, time calculations and runtime are baseline and earn no additional gain.

The entire actual entry is checked before its negligible separate commit, which earns no saving. This task adds no physical pumping, automatic notification or external report; deduplicate any same captured reading with 14609.
unknowns: Actual automatic logging coverage and manual reconciliation effort
research_questions: Can one actual operation's product, stock, gauging and time record be reproduced exactly from verified sources?

already_counted.description: Actual source selection, field capture and complete operating entry writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source and unit mappings and test quantity, reset and time exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete operating data record checked in s5 against actual evidence; changes invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55; gross saving=45 from actual manual import and arithmetic. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 41. Existing automatic logging and the same-system commit earn no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan actual product movement through connected pipelines, pumps and tanks

steps.what: Read the actual transfer request and verify product, quantity, destination, timing and current operating constraints
inputs: Actual product movement request
Existing transfer planning and plant status system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Actual verified movement requirement and source constraints

steps.what: Determine the actual feasible route using current pipeline and valve interconnections, pump availability, tankage, compatibility and capacities
inputs: Actual requirement from s1
Current verified plant diagrams, availability and physical status evidence
outputs: Human-selected route and captured actual capacity, rate and stock values with explicit calculation rules

steps.what: Calculate exact selected capacity margins and expected transfer durations from the captured route values and explicit rules
inputs: Actual selected route values and explicit rules captured in s2
outputs: Draft route capacity and duration calculations with source values

steps.what: Write the actual product movement plan and check its entire final route, assumptions, calculations, constraints and unresolved conditions
inputs: Actual route decision from s2 and exact calculations from s3
Original request and current plant evidence
outputs: Exact complete checked actual movement plan with validity conditions

steps.what: Save the exact checked movement plan as a plan, preserving its validity conditions
inputs: Exact complete plan checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual product movement plan

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} arithmetic for explicit capacity margins and duration estimates on a route selected by the operator. Keep route feasibility, current plant verification and actual plan writing and final checking human in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: A selected movement route can require repeated manual capacity and duration arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculation views can reproduce explicit arithmetic from operator-verified values.
tasks.still_hard: Nominal connectivity and capacity do not establish current valve status, product compatibility or route availability.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a feasible route that fits current physical and operational constraints.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit capacity and duration arithmetic can be configured without automating route selection or changing pumps and valve states.

assumptions: This conditional planning episode has actual manual calculations and an actual written plan. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the prompt prior.

Actual requests and existing plant records are baseline sources. The operator verifies current constraints and explicitly captures all selected route values and formulas in s1-s2; no clean plant graph, live status feed or automatically inferred compatible route is assumed.
Use native calculations first; existing capacity or duration calculations are baseline and earn no new gain. Missing or changed plant facts require retained human resolution, not a guessed result.

All substantive plan writing and full final checking remain in s4. The separate save is negligible and earns no saving. A saved plan does not start a transfer, send instructions or grant operating authority.
Any actual issue or execution needs a separate final-version and current-state check and its own gated action; communication is separately represented in 14611 rather than silently executed here.
unknowns: Actual existing planning calculations and current-state verification effort
research_questions: Which exact arithmetic still occurs manually after an operator selects a real feasible route?

already_counted.description: Actual requirement verification, route selection and complete plan writing and checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain explicit calculation rules and verify unit and capacity exceptions after approved changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact entire movement plan and stated validity conditions checked in s4; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving=20 from actual manual arithmetic. Deduct 3 incremental hours once for net 17. Route judgement, current-state checks and save earn no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate actual start and stop flow instructions to other workers

steps.what: Verify current transfer readiness and the exact product, line, receiving worker and start instruction under the existing operating procedure
inputs: Actual authorised transfer and current physical state
Existing transfer control view, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
outputs: Exact checked current start instruction and receiving worker, or a stop

steps.what: Communicate the exact checked start-flow instruction by signal, radio or telephone and confirm the other worker's understanding
inputs: Exact current start instruction and recipient checked in s1
outputs: Actual start instruction received and confirmed, or unresolved communication

steps.what: Check actual transfer status and the exact required stop instruction, line and receiving worker against current conditions
inputs: Actual subsequent transfer state and existing operating instruction
outputs: Exact checked current stop instruction and recipient, or an unresolved condition

steps.what: Communicate the exact checked stop-flow instruction by signal, radio or telephone and confirm the other worker's understanding
inputs: Exact current stop instruction and recipient checked in s3
outputs: Actual stop instruction received and confirmed, or unresolved communication

tasks.design: Retain actual start and stop communication and the existing current-state checks. The existing {OPS_SYSTEM} view supports those checks but does not send instructions or operate equipment automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: A stored plan cannot establish that the current flow state and receiving worker are ready for a particular instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communications already support direct confirmation; no additional change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous signals or changed operating conditions require immediate human clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm the right worker understands the exact instruction for the actual flow.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operational start and stop communications depend on current state and explicit understanding by the workers involved.

assumptions: This illustrative cycle contains both actual start and stop instructions; shares count active focal effort, not waiting or equipment runtime, and are independent of the prompt prior.

Both instructions are separate internal sends and retain their actual active communication effort. Each is gated by the exact current instruction check; changed state or instruction requires renewed checking. Existing emergency procedure is not delayed.
Other workers' physical control work remains unchanged and is not claimed as focal saving. No automated radio message, remote start or stop is proposed.

No separate communication record or report is established here. If the actual procedure requires one, split and count its actual preparation and gated commit rather than hiding it inside the conversation. Existing control views are baseline.
unknowns: Actual instruction and confirmation sequence and any separate communication log
research_questions: Observe actual flow communication for an additional real record or report step.

already_counted.description: Actual current-state and exact-instruction checks remain counted.

incremental.description: No change is proposed, so no additional upkeep labour is introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Exact current start instruction and receiving worker checked in s1; any change requires a new check.
Exact current stop instruction and receiving worker checked in s3; any change requires a new check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0 after splitting current-state checks and both actual sends. Live instruction and confirmation effort remain fully retained; no unestablished paperwork is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Maintain explicit capacity and quantity formulas
